message: Magic Control Pro v2.3 is available with the new Peek application, updated interface and expanded value delivery controls.
notes: Magic Control Pro v2.3 adds the standalone Peek application at /peek, Wi-Fi and Peek delivery controls for Calculator and Notes, configurable Peek value transitions, Russian interface support, mobile viewport and safe-area fixes, updated touchbar icons, GZIP-compressed application pages, resized Peek wallpapers and a 500 ms Peek polling interval. The confirmed Android Wi-Fi/BSSID fix is preserved. Existing AP credentials, beacon and fake Wi-Fi mechanics, BOOT behavior, OLED behavior and OTA architecture remain unchanged.
